chunks.text: Angola is in Southern Africa.
It is a large country on the Atlantic Ocean.
Angola has borders with Namibia, Zambia, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
The capital city of Angola is Luanda.
Luanda is the largest city in Angola and is next to the ocean.
It is a busy city with many people, businesses, and markets.
Angola has many natural resources like oil and diamonds, which are important for the country's economy.
Nature in Angola.
Angola has beautiful nature.
The country has beaches, rivers, mountains, and forests.
The longest river in Angola is the Kwanza River.
It is very important for the people and the environment.
In the north, there are tropical forests with many trees and animals.
In the south, there are deserts like the Namib Desert.
The desert has tall sand dunes and is very dry.
Angola also has waterfalls like the Kalendula Falls, which are some of the biggest waterfalls in Africa.
People visit these places to enjoy nature and take beautiful pictures.
